meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **budget wedding sarees** ke liye aap online **Meesho, Flipkart, Ajio, Utsav Fashion, aur Mohey** dekh sakti hain, kyunki inme budget-friendly options milte hain aur price range kaafi wide hai.[1][9][13][6][7]

Aapke budget ke hisaab se ye choices practical rahengi:

- **Under ₹1,000:** Meesho par simple sarees, cotton/georgette options, aur kuch silk-look budget pieces milte hain.[13]
- **₹1,000–₹5,000:** Meesho, Flipkart, Ajio, aur some wedding collections par festive sarees, art silk, georgette, aur light embroidery wale options mil jate hain.[1][9][18][19]
- **₹5,000–₹10,000:** Is range mein Meesho par wedding sarees under 10000, aur Utsav Fashion/other festive collections mein better fabric aur design mil sakta hai.[1][6]
- **₹10,000+**: Agar bridal look chahiye, to Mohey, Nalli, Kankatala, aur Kalki jaisi sites par heavier silk, Banarasi, Kanchipuram, aur designer sarees milti hain, lekin ye budget category se upar hain.[7][4][5][8]

**Best budget picks by type:**
- **Wedding guest / function:** georgette, chiffon, art silk, chiffon-blend, aur light embroidered sarees.[9][13]
- **Traditional look on budget:** Banarasi-style, silk-blend, aur festive zari work sarees.[1][10]
- **Bridal-ish budget look:** printed silk, tissue-look, or lightly embellished sarees from budget platforms.[1][7]

**Kya avoid karein:**  
Agar budget tight hai, to pure silk, heavy zari, aur premium handloom collections avoid karein, kyunki unki price usually kaafi higher hoti hai.[4][5][7][14]

Agar aap chahein, main aapke **exact budget** ke hisaab se 5–10 saree types shortlist kar sakta hoon, jaise **₹2,000, ₹5,000, ya ₹10,000** ke andar.
